summary.text: Emilie Kornheiser is a Democratic member of the Vermont House of Representatives for the Windham-7 District who lives in Brattleboro and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her House tenure as beginning in 2019, and her background is in community development.

paragraphs.text: Emilie Kornheiser earned a B.A. in sociology and psychology from Marlboro College in 2000 and an M.S. in public policy, community development, and economics from the University of Vermont.

Her career experience includes work as a development associate for the International Executive Service Corps, program leader for Community Connections of Vermont, community development specialist for the State of Vermont, and director of workforce development for Youth Services Inc.
In the 2019-2020 session Kornheiser served on the Government Accountability Committee and was clerk of the Commerce and Economic Development Committee.

In the 2023-2024 session she was vice chair of the Ways and Means Committee and of the Joint Fiscal Committee, and also served on the Joint Carbon Emissions Reduction Committee and the Joint Public Pension Oversight Committee.
